details:
Description

I am unable to clone my friends’ avatars. Regardless of whether my friend has enabled avatar cloning, the game always displays “This model has cloning disabled.” I am also unable to favorite avatars. There are no issues with my safety settings, and I have already cleared the cache and reinstalled VRChat, but the problem persists. I have not committed any violations of VRChat’s rules. I hope this issue can be resolved as soon as possible.

Reproduction Steps

Log in to VRChat and join a world with a friend.

Ask the friend to enable avatar cloning for their avatar.

Open the friend's profile  to select "Clone Avatar".

The system incorrectly shows "This model has cloning disabled" (此模型已关闭克隆), even though cloning is actually enabled.

Try to click "Favorite" on any avatar in the menu. The action fails, and the avatar is not added to the favorites list.
